description: Analyze spin density of bulk V2O3 (corundum, R-3c).
user_prompt: Perform spin density analysis on bulk V2O3 (corundum structure, R-3c). Determine whether the system has unpaired electrons. If unpaired electrons are present, identify the atom carrying the majority of the spin density by its element and report its magnetic moment; otherwise report that there is no spin-carrying element and report the maximum residual site magnetic moment.

references: Ezhov, Anisimov, Khomskii & Sawatzky, Phys. Rev. Lett. 83, 4136 (1999)
method.modeling: Bulk V2O3 in the corundum structure (R-3c) primitive cell. AFM Mott insulator: every V is V3+ (3d2, EgEg high-spin S=1) and carries a local moment, so the cell total is ~0 by AFM cancellation and the scored quantity is the per-V moment magnitude, not the total.
method.rationale: Value 1.7 uB from Ezhov et al. 1999, whose LDA+U gives ~1.7 uB per V nearly the same across all magnetic structures studied (also matching the high-temperature susceptibility moment; neutron diffraction gives a smaller ordered moment of 1.2 uB). Note their LDA+U is the rotationally-invariant (Liechtenstein) scheme with U=2.8 eV, J=0.93 eV, not a single Dudarev U_eff; the recommended Dudarev U(V 3d)~3.4 eV here is a separate VASP-protocol choice. Tolerance 0.3 uB (absolute) covers this U-scheme/U-value sensitivity and the typical inter-method scatter for transition-metal cation localised moments.
